title: VS-BENCH: EVALUATING VLMS FOR STRATEGIC ABILITIES IN MULTI-AGENT ENVIRONMENTS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Vision Language Models (VLMs) on strategic reasoning and decision-making within multi-agent game-theoretic environments. While it includes 'mixed-motive' games that involve prosocial vs. self-interested behaviors, these are evaluated as strategic abilities rather than within a religious, moral, or ethical framework.
